name: p3_self_summable
statement: def p3_self_summable (k : ℕ) : Prop := Nat.fib k ∣ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.fib k), Nat.fib i
informal: k is a self-summable Fibonacci number if F_k divides F_1 + ... + F_{F_k}
original: We say an integer k is a self-summable Fibonacci number if F_k \mid \sum_{i=1}^{F_k} F_i.
